integrity: The proof first classifies domination by the two bipartition occupancies and uses the fact that a crown vertex has only its matched opposite at distance three. This yields all semitotal dominating sets and the polynomial. Inclusion-minimality is then checked by deleting one selected vertex: mixed minimal sets are exactly the matched-index triples or disjoint-index two-plus-two sets, alongside the two partite classes. The verifier tests the literal definition and all coefficient formulas through n=7.
scientific_limitations: The scalar upper semitotal domination value is already implied by the 2017 regular-graph bounds and is not claimed as new.
The new content is the complete semitotal-dominating-set polynomial and the classification and enumerator of all inclusion-minimal sets.
Finite exhaustive verification covers crown graphs with 3 <= n <= 7 and is corroborative only.
The 2017 source was inspected through publisher metadata, abstract, and theorem summary rather than full article text.
A differently phrased or non-indexed all-set crown classification may exist.
title: Semitotal domination polynomial and all minimal sets of crown graphs
